## About

I work at the intersection of mathematics and practical decision-making
under uncertainty. My experience spans quantitative finance, real-time
bidding, credit, fraud, and business performance — covering stochastic
modelling, forecasting, experimentation, and policy design.

I write up the technical notes I keep for myself — on experimentation
design, optimization and stochastic modeling — when they turn out useful
enough to share. See [Projects & Articles](projects.qmd) for the polished
ones and [Blog](blog.qmd) for looser, occasional notes.
